text:
Sasha: Quick follow-up from last outage. I want a tighter postmortem follow-up cadence and an explicit remediations ownership flow so things don't drift.
Kevin: +1. We stalled after the RCA.
Maria: What cadence are you suggesting?
Sasha: Draft: T0=incident. T+24h=assign remediation owner + short RCA summary. T+72h=remediation plan (owners + ETAs). T+14d=verification (test evidence). T+30d=closure + recurrence analysis.
Aj: Add automated reminders at T+24h, T+72h, T+14d, T+30d. OpsTracker should post ownership snapshots.
incident-bot: OpsTracker: reminders scheduled for thread 1872509876 at T+24h, T+72h, T+14d, T+30d. Will post outstanding items.
Priya: IC rotation: monthly among on-call leads. If someone is out, fallback to previous on-call. Require IC handoff note in-thread using a brief template.
Kevin: Template suggestion:
IC Handoff:
- Outgoing IC: name
- Incoming IC: name
- Current state (3 bullets)
- Open actions: owner + ETA
- Next check-in (datetime TZ)
Sasha: Important: remediation owner must be distinct from IC. IC coordinates; owner is accountable for the fix and timelines.
Maria: At T+30 flag "pattern review" if recurrence suspected and tag Research/Infra to check signatures across incidents.
Aj: Recommend weekly 15m remediation sync for actions older than 7 days to avoid blockers.
Priya: External comms: keep status posts until T+72h, then consolidated postmortem after closure. Legal/Comms cc'd for regulated customers.
Kevin: Also propose soft SLAs as guidance: P1 ack in 12h, mitigation in 72h, target remediation 7-14d. Pilot for 90 days.
Sasha: I'll write a one-page runbook (cadence, IC rota, acceptance criteria for closing actions: owner confirms, test evidence attached, docs updated) and post to #eng-oncall. Will enable OpsTracker reminders for pilot incidents.
Aj: I'll join the pilot rota.
Priya: me too.
Kevin: count me in.
